issues.description: The source first places the newly created black hole near Mars, then says it formed when the object exploded between Jupiter and Saturn.
issues.current_treatment: Both source statements are preserved; the language adaptation does not choose a canonical location without the author's decision.

issues.description: The source describes the Sun-Earth L3 point as lying between the Sun and Earth, although the rest of the explanation relies on the station being hidden from Earth.
issues.current_treatment: Preserved from RU_SOURCE_MASTER; correcting the astronomical location would change an established source fact.

issues.description: Serhii says that five senior-ranked people must go to the command center and immediately asks Henry to let Julia join them, although the visible group consists of Henry, Serhii, Julia, Takonashi, and Sean.
issues.current_treatment: The source numeral five and the following request about Julia are both preserved; the adaptation does not silently change the personnel count.

issues.description: The source calls the artificial black hole supermassive but later gives its final mass as 228 tonnes and describes a microscopic event horizon.
issues.current_treatment: The technical qualifier is preserved as «надмасивний» because removing it would silently edit the source claim; scientific correction requires an author decision.
